name: Witnessed by default — the moat on the page people actually open
one_liner: Expose the existing zero-token witness fan-out (ownership/growth/earnings-basis/52w/market-cap) as a read-only GET and render its conflicts inline in the overview fundamentals cells, so a keyless user sees Yahoo's 141x-wrong institutions figure next to the BSE filing's value instead of as plain fact.
rides_on: sidecar/services/research/fast.py:261-402 (snapshot_structured; witnesses attached at :376-402; only callers are LLM-started research: agent_tools/deep_research.py:750, research/deep.py:1035, research/iter.py:339,915)
new_parts: conflict slot in FundamentalValueCell (data_conflict amber tick inline; definitional on hover)
risk: Bank/definitional conflicts fire on nearly every open and drown the signal; mitigated by inlining only data_conflict and moving definitional pairs to hover.

name: Proof Open — the first minute is a demonstration, not a tour
one_liner: A keyless first-run step before the key form: name a company, and in ~8 s a 'What we checked' card shows each witness as agrees / disagrees-here-are-both / couldn't-check-why, turning the product's accuracy claim into something a sceptic can verify.
rides_on: src/components/OnboardingFlow.tsx:58 (Step state machine), :224-290 (WelcomeStep copy), :250 ('It already works — no key')
new_parts: ProofStep before welcome; key paths move after it
'What we checked' card component (reused by designer-6)
smoke-test coverage of the witnessed route
risk: An all-agree large cap makes the moment look empty, and a broken exchange lane shows 'couldn't check' on the showcase screen; mitigated by an explicit positive receipt and a suggested BSE-only example.

name: Instant Cockpit — paint the last-known world, stamped with its age
one_liner: Mirror the autosave layout and a bounded last-seen value map into the app-data dir via Rust so the cockpit paints in <200 ms before the sidecar binds, each cached figure visibly aged ('close 18 Sep') until it fades to live.
new_parts: Rust read_text_in_app_data command with a two-name allow-list
layout mirror + last_seen.json written on the autosave debounce
'cached' freshness state; no tick-flash on cached-to-live
risk: A cached price read as live during market hours; the cached tone and date stamp must be unmistakable and never flash.

name: The Figure, and the Why key — every number explains itself in place
one_liner: A design-system <Fig> primitive replaces native title= tooltips with a focusable figure; pressing ? opens an in-cell lineage card (inputs, provider, as-of, basis, witness verdicts, filing link, copy-as-citation) with no LLM, and a second ? optionally adds one model line.
new_parts: ? binding scoped to a focused Fig
vitest that lists Figs without lineage
risk: Lineage upkeep per new metric; undeclared lineage shows 'not recorded', which is honest but creates pressure to keep up.

name: One number, one truth — no silent split-brain across panels
one_liner: A client-side figure registry keyed by (symbol, metric, basis) that every <Fig> and every extracted brief claim registers into; when two open panels show different values beyond tolerance, both get a link glyph that explains the difference (e.g. a brief that predates JONJUA's bonus allotment).
new_parts: pure tolerance comparator (price-class compares across as-of days only)
risk: False positives from timing skew between a live quote and a snapshot; price-class metrics compare only across different as-of days.

name: Coverage strip — say what the app cannot see, per company
one_liner: A 4-px segmented bar under the overview header (Price / Statements / Shareholding / Filings / Corporate actions / Estimates), each segment filled, partial or empty with a named reason and fallback, fed by existing per-leg status, FieldMeta counts and the unconsumed /system/provider-health circuit state.
risk: It reads as a 'your data is bad' banner next to tools that hide gaps; kept to 4 px and quiet so labelled gaps make the full segments trustworthy.

name: Ghost edits and ⌘Z — agent changes appear where they land, and every one can be undone
one_liner: Pending agent mutations render as ghost rows/insertions inside the target panel (↵ accept, ⌫ reject), every applied change (incl. AUTO) pushes a pre-image onto an undo stack, and ⌘Z reverses the agent's last change to that panel, refusing with a reason if the user has since edited it.
risk: Undo that clobbers a later user edit; refused with a stated reason when the target changed since apply.

name: Earned autonomy — the agent asks less as it proves it does not need to
one_liner: Replace the global ask/auto switch with per-kind autonomy plus a persisted accept/reject tally; after a clean record (e.g. 23/23 chart changes) the agent offers once to stop asking for that kind, downgrades on the first reject, and never offers for writes to the tracked portfolio.
new_parts: per-kind tally persisted in the workspace blob
risk: It could feel like the product is pushing you towards less oversight; offered once per kind, a permanent 'don't ask', a visible ledger, and portfolio writes are permanently excluded.

name: The turn receipt — one line that says what the answer cost and what it rests on
one_liner: Under every agent turn, one clickable monospace line: tools · sources by origin · checks ok/disagree · tokens · $ (≥ while research is unmetered) · wall time · context n/10 turns, with the context segment warning before history silently drops.
new_parts: context n/10 segment with pin/space action
priced foreground spend, ≥ prefix until COD-research-extraction-synthesis-2 lands
risk: A precise but wrong dollar figure while research calls stay unmetered; rendered as a lower bound (≥) until metering is fixed.
